text:
Anya (CSM): Quick heads-up: BrightCart hit a p99 latency SLO issue during onboarding load tests, customer asking about credits and next steps.
Marco (Ops): Which endpoint and numbers?
Anya (CSM): Generation endpoint, snapshot from last 24h: metric: latency_p99 | value: 620ms | target: <=250ms. Uptime unchanged.
Riley (SRE): Got it. I'll pull traces. Initial hypothesis: cold cache + small batch sizing causing KV cache thrash. When did this surface?
Anya (CSM): Started when their QA ramped traffic two mornings ago; consistently during 11:00-12:30 PST windows.
Jade (BrightCart): Confirmed from QA. This blocks our go-live; need ETA and whether we'll get a credit while you fix it.
Riley (SRE): Short-term mitigations: enable prefix warmup, bump model min-instances in Dedicated pool, and adjust batching policy for their request shapes. I'll run a canary.
Marco (Ops): Cost impact: increasing min-instances estimated +$3.2k/month on their Dedicated capacity. I'll add options (warmup schedule, smart pre-warm) with cost tradeoffs.
Anya (CSM): Proposed customer comms: 1) acknowledge, 2) remediation plan + ETA, 3) provisional credit estimate, 4) invite to a joint postmortem. OK?
SLA Bot: Auto-calc: no downtime; SLO breach (p99 latency exceeded) over rolling 7-day window => provisional credit 0.75% of monthly usage => approx $450 on typical invoice.
Anya (CSM): Jade, would that provisional credit be acceptable while we resolve and follow up with PM?
Jade (BrightCart): Helps. Need timeline though  can you do 48-72h?
Riley (SRE): 48-72h realistic for mitigation + validation. I'll post smoke test results and the rollout command snippet here.
Marco (Ops): Ops will own the rollout and cost note. Also adding a runbook step: schedule a 15m prefix-warmup before their daily peak and enable prefix cache for their model. Internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-latency
Anya (CSM): I'll draft the external message: short summary, steps we're taking, provisional credit, ETA 48-72h, and invite for joint postmortem next week. Will drop draft here for review. :thumbsup:
Riley (SRE): Canary results: p99 dropped to ~240ms after prefix warmup + batching tweak. Running three more smoke windows. Rollout snippet: `rbctl pool update --name brightcart-dedicated --min-instances 4 --prefix-warmup true`
Marco (Ops): Noted. I'll schedule the change during a low-impact window and confirm cost with billing.
Anya (CSM): Drafted message to BrightCart, posting in 15m for approvals. Goal: reassure, avoid renewal risk, and close onboarding.
Jade (BrightCart): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll accept provisional credit pending the PM.
SLA Bot: Reminder: document incident in SLO board and attach traces for audit.
Anya (CSM): Will do. Closing loop once SRE posts final validation.
